timing.revision_behaviour: Freeze the August input vintage and first eligible retained October release; retain corrections separately. Publisher ingestion lag is unknown; 31 December is an operational resolution cutoff, not a guaranteed lag.

known_limits: Unemployment is not total-population income loss, a binding availability diagnosis, agency or AI causation.
Availability is a commissioned research relationship only; no causal or binding income-access category is inferred.

missingness.mechanism: A source release or exact series cell may be absent, suppressed or changed.
missingness.reporting_rule: Withhold resolution when the exact cell cannot be reconstructed; never impute zero.

negative_controls: The fixed equal-probability comparator uses the same source eligibility checks.

risks: selecting a favourable vintage or series after observing it
gaming.detection: Compare frozen code, scope, first-presence receipt and archive hashes.
gaming.suspension_rule: Withhold for ambiguous classifications or conflicting first-release bytes.

reflexivity.risk: An unemployment statistic may be mistaken for binding work availability.
reflexivity.monitor: Keep the stock, access and agency interpretations distinct.

value_of_information.learning_value: Test whether a prospective reported-statistic claim can be resolved faithfully.
value_of_information.next_observation: First retained October 2026 ILO reported unemployment release for CAN/BA:147/SEX_T/AGE_YTHADULT_YGE15.
